title: How To Build A House For Bats
gallery_text: Zine and workshop series operated in Saxtons' River, VT instructing residents on combating rapid population decline of bats + speculative educational trailhead design.

answers.interest: I am extremely interested in the application of the content of this class to an urban mapping context or otherwise as an urban designer/landscape arch. was approaching this class with a mix of interest/hesitation coming from outside cdp but feel very motivated after our first meeting!
answers.suggestions: I would be very interested to interact with demos and tutorials that involve applying&representing environmental data
